examples.ar: الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ فِرَاشًا وَالسَّمَاءَ بِنَاءً.
examples.en: [He] who has made for you the earth a bed and the sky a ceiling.
And when the ignorant address them, they say, 'Peace.'

examples.ar: فِي السَّفَرِ فَوَائِدُ كَثِيرَةٌ مِنْهَا الِاطِّلَاعُ عَلَى الثَّقَافَاتِ.
examples.en: In travel are many benefits, including getting to know other cultures.

examples.ar: السَّعَادَةُ العَمِيقَةُ تَكْمُنُ فِي إِسْعَادِ الآخَرِينَ.
examples.en: Deep happiness lies in making others happy.

examples.ar: يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْأَهِلَّةِ ۖ قُلْ هِيَ مَوَاقِيتُ لِلنَّاسِ وَالْحَجِّ.
examples.en: They ask you about the new moons. Say, 'They are measurements of time for the people and for Hajj.'
He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.

examples.ar: تَعْلَمْنَا كَثِيرًا مِنْ قِرَاءَةِ سِيرَةِ الرُّوَّادِ.
examples.en: We learned a lot from reading the biography of pioneers.
